title.zh: 示例 DSH 插件市场

description.en: A sample format-1 market index listing dsh-project-tasks. Host this JSON and add its URL as a market index in DSH.
description.zh: 一个 format-1 示例市场索引，列出 dsh-project-tasks。托管此 JSON 并把其 URL 加为 DSH 市场索引。

description.en: Project-scoped task kanban: create tasks that belong to a workspace, and let an agent pull, execute, and complete them via task_board_* tools. Host-authoritative ledger with live SSE updates.
description.zh: 按项目归属的任务看板：任务属于某工作区，agent 通过 task_board_* 工具拉取、执行、完成。Host 权威台账，SSE 实时刷新。
